I have many feelings that could express what I think about this game. It actually played an important on me, considering that when I got into the series, I barely knew enough english to understand what was actually going on. So I played it and played it some more, and it paid off :D: 

Like many trilogies , you would be doing it a discredit if you judge it separately from the series. It's an amazingly intricate storyline which builds up with each and every quest you complete, with each character you recruit and with each decision you make. Everything you discovered and worked towards in the past games and DLCs will have some sort of impact on Mass Effect 3, as well as every little thing you ignored. It's an unforgettable experience, which at the time spanned years of excitement. It will get you not only hooked on its stunning plot, but it will have you emotionally invested in the many complex characters and the decisions which revolve around them.  Every little detail is thought out and every situation plays out based on your playstyle and decisions. 

It does have downsides, like the infamous "♥♥♥♥ ending" and a questionable HUD design, but parts of it got improved after release. 

From a technical point of view, in my opinion, it still holds up extremely well with its timeless design. The soundtrack is easily better than everything presented in each and every game since ME3 initially released in 2012. And yes, I both played all those games with amazing soundtracks that you might be thinking about, and my opinion remains the same. 

If you really want to give it a try, do yourself a favour and start from ME1, and import your saves along the way. Or wait until they release the "Legendary Edition" next year which should highlight some improvements. In any case, prepare for an experience which you will not forget anytime soon. I honestly believe there will not be any series, let alone standalone game, that will capture half of what Mass Effect trilogy managed to, "back in the day". In my opinion, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt came closest.
